title: Does the battery forecast beat simple price shapes?
ask: Does the battery forecast beat simple price shapes?
reason: No. A 14-day average shape beat it on both grids.
hypothesis: The day-ahead price forecast captures more of perfect insight than simple price shapes planned the same way.
question: The live batteries plan their hours from a price forecast. Does the forecast earn more than yesterday's prices or the last 14 days' average price shape, planned with the same dispatch, using weather as it was forecast at the time?
prior: Studies of storage find that simple rules using recent prices capture 84–90% of perfect foresight. Our capture figures had been measured with actual weather, which the battery wouldn't have known.
citations: Salles, M., Huang, J., Aziz, M. & Hogan, W. (2017). Potential Arbitrage Revenue of Energy Storage Systems in PJM. Energies 10(8).
method: Same charge-aware dispatch for every rule; scored on settled prices over the v45 window, October 2025 to June 2026.
Weather as forecast one day ahead (Open-Meteo previous runs), for every point and variable.
Skill against the best simple rule with a 95% block-bootstrap interval. Rule fixed in advance: if the interval includes 0 or is negative, drop the forecast-skill claim.
verdict_reason: No, on either grid. The 14-day average shape captured 82.9% of perfect insight in ERCOT and 97.1% in CAISO; the forecast captured 72.2% and 95.1%. Skill is −0.62 and −0.70, with intervals that exclude 0. Even the research version of the model, which saw data after the close, doesn't beat the 14-day shape. The claim is to be restated as price-aware dispatch beating a fixed schedule; the Utilities tab keeps its current wording until that is approved.
lessons: Compare a forecast with the best simple rule, not only with a fixed schedule.
Score a forecast with the inputs it would have had at the time, including the weather forecast.
row_note: capture of perfect insight; no Sharpe
vintage: frozen walk-forward forecasts, 2025-10-12 to 2026-06-27, point-in-time weather
